national_news.title: Defence Minister Launches Naval Infrastructure Projects at Hindustan Shipyard Limited
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched Fleet Support Ship-1 ('Surya'), laid the keel for Fleet Support Ship-5, and inaugurated upgraded Slipway-4 and a 300-tonne Goliath Crane at Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL) in Visakhapatnam.

The newly launched Fleet Support Ship-1 is designed to enhance the Indian Navy's operational reach, endurance, and capability as a first responder and preferred security partner in the Indian Ocean Region.
HSL attained Miniratna Category-I status in 2025, reflecting its improved financial position and crucial role in meeting India's domestic defence manufacturing goals towards Viksit Bharat 2047.

national_news.title: India's National Telemedicine Service eSanjeevani Crosses 50 Crore Teleconsultations
bullets: India's National Telemedicine Service, eSanjeevani, crossed the milestone of 50 crore cumulative teleconsultations across all States and Union Territories, emerging as the world's largest telemedicine implementation in primary healthcare.

Developed by C-DAC Mohali under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, the platform currently supports over 1.42 lakh Ayushman Arogya Mandir spokes, 19,000 medical hubs, and operates in 15 languages.

Women account for over 57 percent of total utilization, and the platform recently integrated an AI-powered Clinical Decision Support System (AI-CDSS) which won the Gold Award under the National Awards for e-Governance 2026.

national_news.title: India and Switzerland Ink Five Agreements to Enhance Bilateral Ties and Mobility
bullets: India and Switzerland signed five agreements in New Delhi covering Migration and Mobility, Young Professionals Exchange, Transportation Technologies, Innovation, and DST-SNSF research collaboration.
PM Modi highlighted the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) with EFTA nations, aiming to attract $100 billion in investment and create 10 lakh direct jobs over 15 years.
Both countries agreed to deepen cooperation across defense production, military exchanges, nuclear energy, life sciences, biotechnology, and trusted supply chain development.

national_news.title: First International Cargo Vessel Flagged Off from Assam to Bangladesh via Brahmaputra
bullets: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal flagged off the first international cargo vessel carrying methanol from Dibrugarh (Assam) to Pangaon Port (Dhaka, Bangladesh), reviving the Brahmaputra (National Waterway-2) as a global trade route after nearly 80 years.
The consignment of methanol was produced by Assam Petro-Chemicals Limited and traversed through the Indo-Bangladesh Protocol Route to reduce logistics costs and road congestion.
An investment of ₹200 crore will be made to establish a new Skill Development Centre at Bogibeel terminal to train 50,000 youths from Assam and the Northeast over the next ten years.

national_news.title: India Finishes Fourth with 85 Medals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026
bullets: India concluded its campaign at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, finishing fourth in the overall standings with 85 medals (21 gold, 27 silver, and 37 bronze).
India achieved a historic clean sweep of gold medals in men's and women's cricket, kabaddi, and hockey.
The Indian women's hockey team won gold for the first time since 1982 by defeating China, while both men's and women's hockey teams secured direct qualification for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics.

national_news.title: Swiss President Visit to India & 2nd India-EFTA Prosperity Summit
bullets: Swiss President Guy Parmelin undertook a three-day state visit to India to review bilateral cooperation in trade, investment, science, and innovation with PM Narendra Modi.
The visit marks the participation in the 2nd India-EFTA Prosperity Summit, celebrating the first anniversary of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA).
Switzerland remains India's largest trade and investment partner among all European Free Trade Association (EFTA) member countries.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Health Department Revises Essential Drug List to Expand Specialised Care
bullets: The Bihar health department has revised its Essential Drug List (EDL) to include specialized medicines and 16 medical devices/consumables for dialysis, cervical cancer, and hemophilia.
Key additions include Factor VIII medicines, Pap smear kits, Karman cannulas, updated rabies treatments, and Tenecteplase for emergency heart attack management.
The expansion of critical drugs to district hospitals, CHCs, and trauma centers aims to reduce out-of-pocket healthcare expenses for needy families.

bihar_news.title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Evaluates Repo Rate Adjustments Amid Inflation Risks
bullets: The RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) convened to review key policy rates, considering a 25 basis point hike to raise the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50%.
The potential rate revision is driven by rising global crude oil prices exceeding the $90/barrel benchmark and Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation rising to 4.82% in August.
The central bank had maintained a real GDP growth target of 6.7% for FY2026-27, with strong domestic economic momentum providing headroom to focus on inflation control.

bihar_news.title: New Mokama Rail Bridge Commissioned over Ganges in Bihar
bullets: A new double-line rail bridge over the Ganges at Mokama began operations with the Mahananda Express, significantly boosting rail capacity between north and south Bihar.
The Rs 2,400 crore project spans 1.86 km (with total project length of 14 km) and was constructed to replace speed restrictions of the old Rajendra Setu, allowing train speeds of up to 140 kmph.
Sanctioned in the 2015-16 Rail Budget and launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in March 2016, the construction was executed by Afcons Infrastructure under IRCON International.
